# JOC Japan Travel

> > Your guide to authentic Japan travel experiences, from Tokyo's observation decks to Kyoto's temples, Hokkaido's winter resorts, and regional food specialties across Kansai, Chubu, and beyond.

JOC Japan Travel, created by Shen Chen (Mr. JOC) and team, offers detailed travel guides covering major destinations like Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, and Hakone, with special emphasis on family-friendly activities, seasonal experiences, and regional cuisine. The site complements Just One Cookbook with location-specific food guides and cultural attractions.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo attractions and observation decks
- Osaka shopping and seasonal guides
- Kyoto temples and UNESCO sites
- Hakone and Lake Ashi experiences
- Hokkaido winter resorts and cuisine
- Regional Japanese food guides
- Family-friendly travel activities
- Fall foliage and seasonal travel
- Kansai region destinations
- Chubu region attractions
- Mt. Fuji viewing spots
- Japanese cultural museums
- Traditional architecture (gassho-zukuri)
- Department store culture (depachika)
- Edo-period historical sites

## Regional Food Guides

- [What to Eat in Hokkaido – 12 Must-Try Foods](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/hokkaido-food-guide-12-must-try): Hokkaido food guide: sea urchin, king crab, ramen & regional specialties
- [What to Eat in Nagoya – 10 Must-Try Local Dishes](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/the-ultimate-nagoya-food-guide-10-must-try-dishes): Nagoya food guide: hitsumabushi, miso katsu & must-try local dishes
- [What to Eat in Yamagata – Local Dishes & Food Guide](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/tohoku-yamagata-what-to-eat): Yamagata food guide: Yonezawa beef, cold ramen & Tohoku regional cuisine

## Tokyo Attractions & Observation Decks

- [Free City Views from Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/tokyo-metropolitan-government-building-observation-decks): Free Tokyo skyline views from Shinjuku Metropolitan Government observation
- [Tokyo City View – Panoramas and Art at Mori Tower](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/tokyo-minato-mori-tower-city-view): Roppongi Hills observation deck with Mori Art Museum & Sky Deck access
- [Asakusa Cultural Tourist Center: Start Your Visit Here](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/tokyo-asakusa-cultural-tourist-information-center): Asakusa tourist center with free Sensoji Temple & Tokyo Skytree views

## Kyoto & Kansai Temples and Culture

- [Visiting Kiyomizu-dera: A Must-See Temple High Above Kyoto](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kansai-kyoto-kiyomizudera-temple): UNESCO Kiyomizu-dera temple guide: nail-free architecture & Otowa waterfall
- [Osaka Autumn Guide – Best Fall Foliage Spots](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kansai-osaka-autumn-foliage-guide): Seasonal guide to Osaka fall foliage at Minoh Park & Katsuo-ji Temple
- [Hankyu and Hanshin – Umeda's Iconic Osaka Department Stores](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kansai-osaka-umeda-department-stores): Osaka's Hankyu & Hanshin department stores in Umeda with depachika halls
- [Amerikamura – Vintage Shops, Street Art, and Trendsetting Vibes in Osaka](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kansai-osaka-amerikamura): Osaka's Amerikamura: vintage fashion, street art & youth culture hub

## Hakone & Lake Ashi Experiences

- [Lake Ashi – Pirate Ships, Shrines, and Scenic Views in Hakone](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kanto-kanagawa-lake-ashi): Hakone's Lake Ashi: pirate ship cruises, shrines & Mt. Fuji views
- [Hakone Sekisho – A Restored Edo-Period Checkpoint by Lake Ashi](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kanto-kanagawa-hakone-checkpoint-museum): Edo-period Hakone Checkpoint Museum with Tokugawa Shogunate history
- [Hakone-en – A Family-Friendly Stop on Lake Ashi](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/kanto-kanagawa-hakone-en): Family activities at Hakone-en: aquarium, petting zoo & Komagatake ropeway

## Hokkaido Winter & Seasonal Travel

- [Hoshino Resorts Tomamu Winter Guide – Ski & Ice Village](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/hokkaido-tomamu-hoshino-resorts-winter-guide): Hokkaido winter resort guide: Tomamu skiing, ice village & Risonare stays
- [Sapporo Clock Tower – The City's Oldest Building and Historic Landmark](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/hokkaido-sapporo-clock-tower): Sapporo's oldest building: Meiji-era Clock Tower museum & landmark

## Chubu Region Destinations

- [Kurashiki Travel Guide](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/chugoku-okayama-kurashiki-travel-guide): Kurashiki travel guide: Bikan Historical Quarter & Edo-era canal district
- [Explore Toyota's Roots – From Looms to Robots in Nagoya](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/chubu-aichi-nagoya-toyota-commemorative-museum): Toyota Commemorative Museum guide: robotics, automotive & textile history
- [Kanda House – Shirakawa-go's Living Museum](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/chubu-shirakawa-go-kanda-house): Shirakawa-go's Kanda House: preserved gassho-zukuri farmhouse museum
- [Senbei-Making Fun at Yume Kojo Hida in Takayama](https://www.jocjapantravel.com/chubu-takayama-yume-kojo-hida): Hands-on senbei rice cracker making experience at Yume Kojo Hida Takayama
